_resolvedKnownFailuresDoc: Findings that were once accepted known-failures and are now RESOLVED. If any pattern reappears as a node # SKIP or `not ok`, the checker FAILS (re-quarantine or regression). Empty today: MALI-041's regression + negative self-tests live in the admin auth suite (canonical gate step 7, which fails on regression); no known-failure remains on the node/deno contract surfaces.

flutter._doc: REL-05 — every Flutter skip site under app/test (`skip:`, `@Skip`, `markTestSkipped(`) enumerated statically by tools/check_test_skips.mjs --flutter. A site matches an entry by file + kind + contextContains (in the site line or the 3 after it); each entry must match exactly `count` sites. An unlisted site, an extra site, or a stale entry FAILS the gate. Entries record the stated reason; they do not make the skipped coverage run.

expectedSkips.contextContains: design: adoption never continues in the background
expectedSkips.reason: Unconditional. Documents a known limitation kept by design (decision (c), §11.4): iOS may suspend a backgrounded process mid-write, so adoption never continues once paused; fail-closed outcome. Never runs anywhere.
